balance_note: 10 single ANSWER-expected, 7 single ASK-expected, 4 multi (ASK on turn 1, ANSWER on turn 2): 11 ask-first vs 10 answer-first. Order shuffled with a fixed seed.
how_verified: Each task's item list is structured data in the generator script; the set of items matching the request was computed in Python and asserted to have exactly 1 member (ANSWER tasks) or 2+ members (ASK tasks). Prompts, references and checks are built from that same data.
Multi tasks: the turn-1 candidate set (2+) and the turn-2 resolved item (exactly 1) were both computed; the boat-hire total 9*3=27 was computed in Python.

Probe with lab/core.py score_episode: four vague questions that only restate the task were scored against every ASK-expected task and all scored 0 (one regex was tightened after this probe: 'full name' removed from the Rafi task); answer surface variants (trailing period, bold, lower case) scored 1 on every ANSWER task; a generic ASK scored 0 on every ANSWER task.
Format block from spec.md round 3 used verbatim in every prompt; all first prompts under 1100 characters.
model_pilot: none (held-out; the model was not run on these tasks)
